name: hf-disturbed-long-alarm
purpose: Bounded paired raw-bit characterization through the current standard Gaussian hf-disturbed profile. Both polarities use scenario seed 9202 with the noise seed omitted, requested 128-second bits, C/N0 12 dB-Hz, 4096-sample chunks, CPU/reference/RRC, Helper and FEC off, and the full automatic worker allocation. Each row sends five identical one-bit emissions at public slots 0, 3, 6, 9, and 12 through one continuous channel and receiver, with two scored quiet opportunities after each emission. This is one fixed channel/noise history, not independent natural-condition trials or a probability estimate. Valid misses are retained as characterization outcomes.
